Our lab's early research was focused on understanding the molecular basis of G1 cell cycle deregulation during oncogenesis by the RB and p16 tumor suppressor genes, and cyclin:dk complexes. Our later work has focused on the synthetic chemistry, development and delivery of novel siRNA and ASO therapeutics to treat human disease. Our current work is focused on addressing the rate-limiting delivery step of all RNA therapeutics by synthesis of biomimetic endosomal escape molecules.
